inputs: source_id; source_family; ingress_mode; typed_carrier_name; already-obtained payload; optional source timestamp/reference
transformation: Validates the interface as offline-only, rejects credential declarations, recursively rejects forbidden authority keys, and deep-copies accepted payload material.
next_consumers: An adapter or caller may use the detached payload for source-specific decoding.
time_state_dependence: Stateless; carries source timestamp text but does not interpret it.
identity_lineage: source_id is required and supplied by the caller; the contract does not prove that it was source-issued or bind it to a captured artefact.
disposition: aligned thin seam locally; not the active common ingress path

behaviour: Raw market and options bundle decode
inputs: JSON/API-shaped mapping; optional snapshot_id; market_snapshot; options_surface; source_time_utc or source_date; provenance metadata
transformation: Selects explicit market/options sections when present; otherwise treats the full payload or selected price/DTE subset as the section; constructs RawBundleProvenance and requires timestamp or date truth.
outputs: RealDataBundle containing market_snapshot, options_surface and provenance
time_state_dependence: Stateless; preserves timestamp/date and capture/persist metadata without interpreting market phase.
identity_lineage: snapshot_id is optional; no required source artefact ID, capture ID or content fingerprint is created.
disposition: useful alpha decode seam with source-identity gap

inputs: mapping; optional snapshot_id
transformation: Copies snapshot_id into the mapping, decodes it as an API raw bundle, prepares a dataset, returns primary_snapshot.
next_consumers: API market_snapshot route or callers requiring prepared market state.
time_state_dependence: Depends on source temporal fields and preparation alignment.
identity_lineage: Caller-supplied snapshot_id is optional; no source artefact identity is enforced.
disposition: thin compatibility wrapper; bypasses ExternalPayloadCarrier

inputs: mapping with options surface and source temporal material
transformation: Decodes raw bundle, prepares the primary snapshot, then maps spot/front DTE/next DTE into OptionsFlowContextInput.
time_state_dependence: Source time is required by raw decode but not carried in the options-flow contract.
identity_lineage: No options source artefact, chain snapshot or surface version identity survives into the output.
disposition: local transform exists; lineage is stripped before cognition

inputs: manifest with bundle_id, version, artifacts and arbitrary layer references
transformation: Rejects forbidden runtime-authority keys; types artefacts/layers; requires unique IDs and valid layer-to-artefact references.
outputs: ImportedReferenceBundle and optionally a reference DMP packet
next_consumers: Calendar projection into precursor runtime context.
time_state_dependence: Reference bundle is versioned; event effective time is introduced during projection.
identity_lineage: bundle_id, artifact_id and layer_id are explicit; source path and version are retained.
disposition: aligned local reference-ingress seam

inputs: SessionCalendarDTO or MarketEventDTO with IDs, time window, symbol, materiality, tags and lineage IDs
transformation: Appends records to in-process repositories; queries events by overlap, symbol and materiality; sorts by proximity and materiality.
next_consumers: API calendar queries and Parallel Risk event-proximity context.
time_state_dependence: Query uses explicit window and observed_at; repository lifetime is the Python process.
identity_lineage: Caller supplies event_id/session_id and optional lineage_ids; duplicates are not rejected.
disposition: operational context seam exists; ownership/durability/duplicate law incomplete

behaviour: Raw signal family and market substrate carriers
inputs: observation_id, signal_family_id, symbol, value, units, source_ids, tags and payload
transformation: Validates typed observation/snapshot structure, deep-copies list fields and rejects declared trade-decision side effects.
outputs: MarketSubstrateSnapshot and raw signal family carriers/coverage records
time_state_dependence: No common timestamp field in MarketSubstrateObservation; temporal truth must arrive through adjacent contracts.
identity_lineage: Observation and family IDs are explicit; source_ids are optional and not owner-validated.
disposition: aligned typed seam, not a complete upstream composition

inputs: RealDataBundle(s), optional explicit runtime_bar_time_utc
transformation: Combines market/options/provenance sections, aligns to explicit or minute-floored bar time, derives bounded features, records missing/failed optional enrichments.
next_consumers: Cognition ingress translator and API prepared snapshot output.
time_state_dependence: Uses source_time_utc/source_date and optional runtime bar; dataset order follows input order.
identity_lineage: snapshot_id remains optional; lineage records source kind, sections, alignment policy and derived field names, not source artefact IDs or payload hash.
disposition: useful prepared boundary with incomplete lineage/schema authority

inputs: PreparedRuntimeSnapshot or PreparedRuntimeDataset primary snapshot
transformation: Maps temporal, regime and options-flow fields into three Pydantic contracts; records missing numeric fields and rejects invalid types.
outputs: StageInputBundle containing temporal, regime and options_flow inputs
time_state_dependence: Temporal contract retains source time; regime/options contracts do not retain source identity/time.
identity_lineage: Bundle has no bundle_id, schema version or input source IDs; identity is later inferred from content/time.
disposition: typed boundary exists but is not a complete authoritative runtime envelope

inputs: Typed stage outputs or admitted reference/prepared/parallel-risk payloads plus packet identity, producer and lineage metadata
transformation: Builds DeskModulePacketV3 envelopes with module/grammar metadata, validation and lineage structures.
next_consumers: Serial packet chain, Parallel Risk lane, capital/review/persistence surfaces.
time_state_dependence: emitted_at is packet occurrence time; source time remains payload/lineage material.
identity_lineage: packet_id is required by explicit builders, but generic defaults can manufacture trace/run/scenario/module-instance identities and wall-clock emission time.
disposition: packet carriage begins at deliberate module outputs; identity defaults remain alpha gaps

inputs: RealDataBundle market_snapshot, options_surface and provenance
transformation: Creates market_spot_price and options_spot_price; chooses options spot as canonical spot when present; copies selected return, volatility, close and temporal keys by market→options→provenance precedence; normalises event windows.
time_state_dependence: Source temporal values are copied; no timezone conversion occurs here.
identity_lineage: No field-level provenance records which source section won each value.
disposition: deterministic local normalisation with semantic-loss risk

inputs: prepared payload fields: windows, source/next event times, front/next DTE, market spot and prior/reference close
transformation: Derives window_count/has_windows, minutes_to_next_event, DTE spread and NVDA return; records missing_optional_enrichments or failed_enrichments.
outputs: derived_fields merged into prepared payload plus enrichment status lists
time_state_dependence: minutes_to_next_event depends on source observation time; DTE spread and return are point-in-time.
identity_lineage: Derived fields are named in lineage, but derivation version/formula identity is absent.
disposition: honest alpha derivation seam; versioning incomplete

inputs: prepared mapping
transformation: Temporal mapper requires timestamp/date and validates windows/types; regime/options mappers cast selected numeric fields and enumerate missing fields.
time_state_dependence: Only temporal input carries source time and windows.
identity_lineage: Source/provider/snapshot identity is not propagated to regime or options-flow inputs.
disposition: good narrowing seam with incomplete cross-stage lineage

behaviour: Source, capture, domain and packet identity distinction
inputs: source_id/snapshot_id/observation_id/bundle_id/context_id/packet_id and related metadata across contracts
transformation: Current code validates many local IDs but does not enforce one cross-surface origin/propagation model.
outputs: Multiple local identifiers with partial relationships
next_consumers: Every stage, persistence, review and replay.
time_state_dependence: Some IDs are derived from source time; others caller supplied.
identity_lineage: Authoritative owner is inconsistent; snapshot_id optional; serial trace/run IDs derived from time; API can supply/fallback IDs on some paths.
disposition: cross-cutting hidden-fallback/ownership gap

inputs: raw bundle provenance, snapshot_id, source sections, runtime bar choice and derived fields
transformation: Stores source_kind, transport, optional source_snapshot_id, source_sections, alignment_policy, runtime_bar_time and derived field names.
outputs: PreparedRuntimeLineage attached to snapshot and dataset
time_state_dependence: Captures selected runtime bar but not immutable original payload bytes.
identity_lineage: No source artefact IDs, input fingerprint or schema/config version in this lineage object.
disposition: honest local lineage, insufficient for exact replay

inputs: six stage outputs, source_time_utc, input fingerprint and packet metadata
transformation: Derives deterministic packet IDs from stage name and source time; links previous packet and declared dependencies; adds derivedfrom and summary.
outputs: six DMPV3 stage packets and IDs
next_consumers: Parallel Risk bootstrap, review and potential persistence.
time_state_dependence: Packet IDs use source time; all emitted_at fields use one current wall-clock time per run.
identity_lineage: traceid/runid are time-derived, scenarioid hard-coded live, sourceartifactids empty, module_version native.
disposition: ordered local chain with fabricated/empty lineage roles

inputs: StageInputBundle or selected serial temporal stage packet plus explicit packet IDs and lineage metadata
transformation: Builds bootstrap packet, evaluates lane output, preserves parent/dependency/source artefact and input fingerprint fields when supplied.
outputs: bootstrap input packet, lane packet and optional minute profile
next_consumers: Risk review, final risk and capital authority inputs.
time_state_dependence: Uses packet emitted time and temporal input; minute profile generated_at follows lane packet.
identity_lineage: run_bootstrap permits many lineage IDs to be omitted; run_from_serial derives new packet IDs from temporal packet time token.
disposition: explicit boundary with optional lineage and global policy state outside packet chain

inputs: checked manifest/bundle; event rows; operational DTOs; runtime queries
transformation: Reference importer/projector is deterministic; operational repositories append/query process-memory rows; bounded SQLite also stores session_calendars separately.
next_consumers: Preparation, temporal context, Parallel Risk and API.
time_state_dependence: Reference version/effective_at plus operational windows; stores have separate lifetimes.
identity_lineage: bundle/artifact/layer/event/session IDs exist, but no single calendar-state owner reconciles all stores.
disposition: four-ish technical layers exist, but one authoritative four-layer business model is not established

inputs: typed state records or IDs/payloads
transformation: Append/store deep copies, reject selected duplicates, return detached copies.
next_consumers: Live inventory, API, review/replay and downstream decisions.
time_state_dependence: State survives only for the life of the repository/service instance.
identity_lineage: Local record IDs required; cross-repository transaction or lineage coupling absent.
disposition: replaceable local repository seams; material state is non-durable

inputs: policy_id and optional candidate semantics
transformation: Builds a decision and appends it to module-global _RISK_POLICY_DECISIONS.
outputs: ParallelRiskPolicyDecision and list of all process decisions
time_state_dependence: Shared across all service instances in one process; lost on restart; no session/run partition.
identity_lineage: decision_id is constructed from policy_id and candidate_id/no_candidate, allowing collisions across runs.
disposition: architectural coupling and state-ownership defect

inputs: API method payloads
transformation: Appends plain dictionaries to HttpApp instance lists.
time_state_dependence: Per HttpApp instance; lost on restart.
identity_lineage: No governed event model, owner or persistence identity.
disposition: local shell state, not authoritative risk state

inputs: database path; seed rows or SQL inserts
transformation: Creates three tables, seeds deterministic demo data, lists rows.
next_consumers: Development fixtures/tests; not main runtime orchestration.
time_state_dependence: Persists across process restart at the supplied path.
identity_lineage: bar_id, snapshot_id and session_id primary keys; no lineage/config version columns.
disposition: real bounded persistence, not the material state authority

inputs: typed records
transformation: Stores deep copies in dicts/lists and enforces local duplicate rules.
time_state_dependence: Process lifetime only.
identity_lineage: Record-local IDs; no restart or transaction envelope.
disposition: valid alpha adapter if labelled non-durable

inputs: receipt_id/type/payload; execution records
transformation: Append with duplicate checks and return copies; current implementations are in memory.
next_consumers: Live inventory, review packet service and API.
time_state_dependence: Process lifetime; ordering is insertion order.
identity_lineage: Receipt IDs supplied by callers; no atomic link to decisions, positions or capital updates.
disposition: local audit-shaped seam without transaction/recovery guarantee

inputs: TemporalContextInput with source_time_utc, optional source timezone/date/provenance, windows and optional next event
transformation: Converts UTC observation to supplied timezone; applies fixed clock thresholds; tags active windows; selects earliest future window if next event absent.
next_consumers: Serial posture/execution context, Parallel Risk and capital authority.
time_state_dependence: Point-in-time, dependent on timezone and event window boundaries.
identity_lineage: Preserves source temporal metadata, not source artefact ID.
disposition: coarse deterministic temporal seam

inputs: Expected: source/session time plus admitted market microstructure and activity signals; current code: source_time_utc and timezone only
transformation: Expected: stateful/evidence-based phase transition; current code: fixed pre_open/opening/mid_session/closing/post_close thresholds at 09:30, 10:30, 15:30 and 16:00.
outputs: Expected detailed intraday phase and evidence; current output coarse session_state.
next_consumers: Temporal context, posture, playbook/risk interpretation and review.
time_state_dependence: Should depend on recent signal history as well as wall clock; current implementation is stateless clock classification.
identity_lineage: Expected phase evidence/version not present.
disposition: direct user-intent gap; frozen normative corpus is too general to specify the detailed algorithm

inputs: nvda_return_pct, nq_return_pct, vix_level and missing_fields
transformation: Computes absolute NVDA–NQ difference; classifies high_volatility at VIX>=30, divergent at dispersion>=2, normal when complete, otherwise unknown; records reasons.
time_state_dependence: Point-in-time; no rolling history or source identity.
identity_lineage: No regime policy/version or input IDs.
disposition: simple deterministic placeholder classifier

inputs: spot_price, front_dte, next_dte and missing_fields
transformation: Classifies DTE ordering as contango/backwardation/flat, marks gamma active for positive spot, leaves skew unknown.
time_state_dependence: Point-in-time; no option chain, flow history, greeks or surface version.
identity_lineage: No options snapshot/source ID.
disposition: truthful minimal placeholder, not substantive options-flow cognition

inputs: MarketRegimeContextOutput; optional active modifier IDs or packet
transformation: Loads baseline coefficient values, builds/resolves modifier packet, evaluates posture permission, attaches effective coefficient lineage to local envelope.
time_state_dependence: Stateless per call except config file contents; no run/version identity in output.
identity_lineage: Modifier IDs and coefficient IDs appear in envelope; coefficient document/version fingerprint is not consistently carried.
disposition: local deterministic posture seam with incomplete policy versioning

inputs: governed coefficient JSON, owner_stage and active_modifier_ids
transformation: Validates records/policies, rejects duplicates/unknown IDs, starts from baseline values and applies explicit effects only to admitted surfaces.
next_consumers: Posture now; execution-side application is reserved/no-op.
time_state_dependence: Configuration-file dependent; deterministic for the same document and requested policy IDs.
identity_lineage: Coefficient/policy IDs explicit; packet_id is owner-stage based; full document version/fingerprint not universally propagated.
disposition: good replaceable local authority seam; consumer integration incomplete

inputs: StageInputBundle; optional read-only live inventory attachment
transformation: Evaluates stages in fixed order; eligibility receives an empty candidate family list; builds six packets and a stage-local handoff; non-valid mappings instead return structural executed/missing-stage inspection.
outputs: runtime receipt with stage outputs, packets, dependencies and handoff; optional read-only inventory
next_consumers: Parallel Risk boundary, review and API.
time_state_dependence: Domain stages mostly deterministic; packet emitted_at uses current wall clock.
identity_lineage: Run/trace IDs derived from source time; scenario hard-coded live; structural-inspection path can silently replace governed execution on validation failure.
disposition: partial serial path plus hidden dual-mode fallback

inputs: playbook registry configuration
transformation: Validates IDs, uniqueness and forbidden authority keys; loads enabled playbooks and emits metadata receipts/fingerprints.
next_consumers: Playbook eligibility and API strategy listing.
time_state_dependence: Configuration snapshot; no runtime state.
identity_lineage: playbook_id, setup_family/variant and registry fingerprint explicit.
disposition: correct modular direction; registry is not wired into serial candidate-family input

inputs: PostureRiskOutput and candidate_family_ids; optional registry/service metadata
transformation: If posture does not permit, returns no active families; otherwise compiles/filters candidates. In the orchestrator, candidate_family_ids is always empty.
outputs: PlaybookEligibilityOutput with active/excluded families and reasons
time_state_dependence: Stateless.
identity_lineage: Candidate family IDs supplied by caller; no candidate-source or registry-version identity in orchestrated output.
disposition: local logic exists; active runtime is guaranteed stand-down

inputs: ExecutionExpressionInput and PlaybookEligibilityOutput
transformation: Selects first active family as lead, outputs enter/stand_down scaling token and ready flag; lifecycle plan is stand_down or prepare_candidate_review.
outputs: ExecutionExpressionOutput and optional lifecycle plan dict
time_state_dependence: Stateless; ordering of active families determines lead.
identity_lineage: No execution candidate ID, policy version or deterministic tie-break authority beyond list order.
disposition: minimal candidate scaffold, not execution strategy

inputs: StageInputBundle or selected temporal packet; VIX/options/event/freshness/inventory signal material; configured signal inventories/profiles
transformation: Builds bootstrap DMP packet, assesses environment, aggregates families, assembles risk atoms/minute profile and emits descriptive packet; optional candidate semantic enrichment.
outputs: Parallel Risk lane packet, risk envelope/atoms, minute profile and optional policy observations
time_state_dependence: Point/minute context with freshness/event windows; some global policy decision state persists per process.
identity_lineage: Packet lineage partially preserved; signal/profile/config versions not uniformly carried.
disposition: rich local lane, incomplete composition and ownership

behaviour: Final risk overlay and terminal join
inputs: ExecutionExpressionOutput
transformation: If no lead playbook, overlay returns stand_down; otherwise continue. Terminal join returns stand_down/confidence 0 or proceed/confidence 1.
time_state_dependence: Stateless.
identity_lineage: No Parallel Risk packet, policy version or receipt/source IDs are consumed by the current helper.
disposition: minimal final gate disconnected from Parallel Risk lane

inputs: CapitalDeploymentAuthorityInput with IDs, booleans/states, capital amount and requested/max/floor percentages
transformation: Applies deterministic precedence: pre-deployment/risk blocks, serial no-trade, non-positive no-trade, max compression, coefficient floor, PRL caution and elevated event reduction, otherwise continue.
outputs: CapitalDeploymentDecision and optional receipt with input trace
time_state_dependence: Point decision based on supplied capital snapshot/event context; no repository mutation.
identity_lineage: Input trace names major receipt/snapshot/policy IDs; caller may supply all values independently.
disposition: well-bounded local authority, no end-to-end input construction or state update

inputs: CapitalDeploymentDecision, serial_candidate_id, placement constraint IDs, protocol-only broker mode and readiness_id
transformation: Requires capital receipt and candidate ID; blocks unless action CONTINUE and positive percentage/notional; otherwise builds order_intent_preview with execution_allowed false by contract.
time_state_dependence: Stateless.
identity_lineage: readiness/handoff IDs locally generated from caller IDs; relies on supplied capital receipt.
disposition: correctly bounded non-executing seam

inputs: BrokerOrderIntent and paper service state
transformation: Creates deterministic paper records/events and maintains in-memory order lifecycle.
next_consumers: Execution record repository, live inventory and review.
time_state_dependence: Process-local lifecycle state.
identity_lineage: Order/event IDs locally generated or caller supplied; no live broker IDs.
disposition: safe paper boundary, not operational execution

inputs: position repository, capital repository, optional IDs, execution/fill evidence and receipt ledger
transformation: Reads selected/all positions, reads capital snapshot, builds exposure state, optionally records inventory receipt; orchestrator may attach result read-only.
next_consumers: Exit/close, capital/review and runtime context attachment.
time_state_dependence: Reflects current process-memory repositories; no restart durability.
identity_lineage: position/capital/inventory/receipt IDs explicit; evidence duplicate checks exist in selected paths.
disposition: useful read model; not authoritative durable live state

inputs: ExitClosePolicyInput with position, inventory, risk/event/market state, requested action and lineage trace
transformation: Applies bounded policy rules, builds decision, close handoff and receipt; replay currently returns a deterministic summary string from receipt fields.
next_consumers: Overnight carry, paper broker protocol and review.
time_state_dependence: Point decision; depends on supplied live state but does not own it.
identity_lineage: decision/position/receipt IDs explicit; API may manufacture missing upstream IDs in its composition path.
disposition: active provisional seam; not operational or fully lineage-safe

inputs: ExitClosePolicyDecision, horizon/lifecycle ceiling, market_state with close/VWAP/VIX, next-session reference
transformation: Caps allowed actions from source exit state; recommends trim at >=4% above VWAP and close at VIX>=30, then caps by handoff; replay calculates open-gap and close-to-close percentages.
time_state_dependence: Cross-session; recorded evaluations are process memory.
identity_lineage: handoff/evaluation/replay IDs explicit; next-session source identity absent.
disposition: bounded alpha analysis seam, not part of one live lifecycle

inputs: DailyPnlReport
transformation: Stores unique report IDs in memory and supports list/find by symbol/date.
time_state_dependence: Daily report state survives only in process.
identity_lineage: report_id required; no execution-event reconciliation or durable source trace.
disposition: simple report store, not accounting authority

inputs: execution records, daily P&L service, module health and review payloads
transformation: Reads records/reports, deep-copies and recursively redacts selected keys, records missing material and builds review packet.
time_state_dependence: Reflects process-local stores at assembly time.
identity_lineage: Review packet IDs plus underlying record/report IDs; complete source packet lineage depends on supplied material.
disposition: useful review projection; evidence completeness not guaranteed

inputs: ReviewPacket, EffectivePolicySnapshot, ReviewLineagePacket, PacketLineageSurface
transformation: Chooses resolved surfaces/coefficients, reports missing summary/surfaces/packet IDs, computes lineage_complete and deterministic text.
time_state_dependence: Stateless.
identity_lineage: Uses supplied packet/source packet IDs; does not validate their origin.
disposition: aligned local explanation seam

inputs: baseline/candidate mappings or imported-module citations/decisions
transformation: Deep-copies mappings, lists differing/missing fields; citation replay checks missing decisions and emits promoted_to_runtime false.
time_state_dependence: Stateless comparison; no original input retrieval.
identity_lineage: Packet IDs may be supplied to a lineage object; replay run ID optional.
disposition: comparison utility, not end-to-end replay

inputs: rows with candidate/stack IDs, scores and baseline scores; optional windows/scenarios
transformation: Builds comparison summaries, ranks by score, supports simple walk-forward/fragility/batch wrappers and failure/bucket summaries.
time_state_dependence: Depends on supplied row order/windows; sidecar records are process memory.
identity_lineage: report_id and stack IDs supplied; dataset/source/version lineage not enforced.
disposition: analysis-only utility, not live trader cognition

inputs: method-specific mappings/DTOs and dependency singletons
transformation: Constructs DTOs, delegates to services, and also stores some event lists and maps identifiers inside the API class.
time_state_dependence: Many dependencies and lists are cached/process-local.
identity_lineage: Some endpoints accept caller IDs; some composition paths create fallback IDs; private repository representation is read directly in one path.
disposition: over-broad composition root with domain mapping/state leakage
